name: Price Pattern
description: The price content ontology design pattern. This CP represents the price of an entity in a certain currency.
competency_questions: How much does a given item cost, and in which currency is that amount expressed?; Which items are priced in a given currency?; Which items cost more than a given amount when the amounts are in the same currency?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
